name: sb-nuxt-template
description: A simple Nuxt 4 template to start your projects quickly.
author: Stefano Biddau <biddau.stefano99@gmail.com>

_comment_dependencies.nuxt: exact pin on purpose (no caret): every Nuxt bump is re-validated with typecheck + build + nuxt dev before it lands
_comment_dependencies.typescript: held at 6.x: TypeScript 7 ships no classic JS compiler API, which vue-tsc/@volar (nuxt typecheck) needs, and @typescript-eslint peers typescript <6.1.0 (note typescript@7.0.2)
_comment_dependencies.minimatch: transitive, build/lint tools only: GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 (moderate) fixed only in 11.x; 10.2.6 stays via archiver 8.0.0 (nitropack) -> readdir-glob ^3 and via typescript-estree/import-x versions held by the lockfile (note minimatch@11.0.1)
_comment_dependencies.esbuild: override kept for dedup only, see _comment_overrides (note @intlify/bundle-utils@esbuild ^0.28)
_comment_dependencies.cookie-es: transitive, npm ls invalid: 1.2.3 (for the h3 1 nested in @nuxtjs/i18n) sits where i18n resolves its own ^3.1.1; i18n only calls parse(), same in v1 (note cookie-es@3.1.1)
_comment_dependencies.@devframes/agentic: transitive, dev tools only: devframe 1.4.0 (via @nuxt/fonts) wants optional peer 1.4.0, the lockfile keeps 1.3.2 from @eslint/config-inspector; npm ls warns, nothing breaks (note @devframes/agentic@1.4.0)
_comment_dependencies.@vitejs/devtools: transitive, dev tools only: DevTools v4 brings @vitejs/devtools(-kit) 0.8.3, while vite-plugin-vue-devtools rc still lists optional peer ^0.7.6; npm install warns ERESOLVE, nothing breaks (note @vitejs/devtools@0.8.3)

_comment_overrides: esbuild pinned to ^0.28.0 for dedup only (GHSA-67mh is fixed from esbuild 0.25.0 and every other consumer accepts 0.28): @nuxtjs/i18n -> @intlify/bundle-utils 11.2.8 still asks ^0.25.4, and without this override npm would install two esbuild copies. Drop it once bundle-utils moves to ^0.28 (note @intlify/bundle-utils@esbuild ^0.28)
